chrome4._comment: Attaches to a Chrome running with remote debugging. We launch it with the chrome-dev CLI (github.com/ppezzull/chrome-dev): `chrome-dev 9226` starts a blue-colored Chrome instance on port 9226 with its own profile at ~/.chrome-dev-profiles/chrome-mcp-9226 (so it never clobbers daily browsing). `chrome-dev stop 9226` stops it. chrome-devtools-mcp does NOT launch Chrome — it only connects to --browser-url, so start the instance first. Port/color is arbitrary; pick any free chrome-dev port (9223 red / 9224 default / 9225 green / 9226 blue).
